question.question_text: Where is the microwave placed in relation to the fridge in the kitchen?

answer_options.text: The microwave is placed on a shelf next to the fridge
The microwave is placed in a different room form the fridge.
The microwave is placed on the sink counter on the opposite wall of the fridge.
The microwave is placed in a lower cabinet beside the fridge
The microwave is placed directly above the fridge

shared_investigation.established_facts: The microwave is on a countertop in the kitchen. The microwave is not placed on a shelf next to the fridge, in a different room from the fridge, on the sink counter on the opposite wall of the fridge, in a lower cabinet beside the fridge, or directly above the fridge.
